name: Guatemala
dek: La Aurora, WMO 78641. Guatemala City's airport, at 1,491 m.
paragraphs: The reference station is La Aurora, WMO 78641, height 1,491 m, at Guatemala City's airport. The highlands, the Petén, and the coasts are not this table. The same collection has a file named INSIVUMEH at almost the same coordinates, with a different precipitation table and much lower temperatures; that file was not averaged in and was not substituted. No official driving-side or tipping page was opened on this pass, so those lines are missing.

The highest average high in the table is 32.4 °C, in May. The lowest average low is 19.4 °C, in January. The wettest month by the precipitation column is July, at 410.0 mm, and the driest is April, at 142.5 mm.

climate.caption: Reference station: La Aurora, WMO 78641, Guatemala City's airport. Not a national average.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3. INSIVUMEH, in the same collection, sits almost at the same coordinates and prints a different precipitation table and much lower temperatures; it was not averaged with La Aurora and was not substituted.

season: The National Hurricane Center says the eastern Pacific hurricane season runs from 15 May to 30 November, and the Atlantic hurricane season from 1 June to 30 November.
The same page says the Atlantic basin includes the Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of Mexico. Guatemala has a coast on each ocean.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type A and B, 120 V, 60 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Guatemala at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Guatemala, last reviewed September 03, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Quetzal and the code GTQ for Guatemala.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give Guatemala one row, America/Guatemala. There is no second zone for the country in either file.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.note: Guatemala's official tourism institute site. An automated request to the Instituto Guatemalteco de Migración site did not return the page, so this official government tourism site is the link that was opened. We do not restate a visa rule.
